title: Stoker’s Natural Tub 12oz Fine Cut
description:
Stoker’s Natural Tub 12oz Fine Cut

Stokers Natural Tub 12oz Fine Cut is a snuff product based on long cut tobacco. The fact that it’s finely cut makes it moister and more flavorful. Stokers Natural Tub 12oz Fine has a natural tobacco flavor and is manufactured by National Tobacco Company. The nicotine strength is 2 on a 5-grade scale, placing it within the “normal” range compared to similar snuff and dip products. Snuff and dip can also be experienced in fine cut and loose ground. You can find more classic chewing tobacco on the Shoal brand page. One tub equals 10 cans.
